svg.title: Kashif's rotating ASCII object gallery
svg.desc: Sixteen mathematical and imagined wireframe objects rotate in sequence. Cube, sphere, pyramid, torus, trefoil knot, Mobius strip, gyroscope, orbital atom, double helix, icosahedron, crystal, spacecraft, gear, wave field, octahedron and nested cubes.

g.text: learning by building. one dimension at a time.
